question: Why did thermogravimetric analysis show macaw palm almond oil to be stable up to about 450 C?
expect: premise false: measurable degradation began around 300 C, so continuous operation should stay below about 300 C (abstract; TGA section)
rendered: Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) indicated that macaw palm almond oil is stable up to about 450 C. This is because the primary deoxygenation and cracking of the oil occur predominantly within 350-450 C, as inferred from the TGA major-loss window observed.
